image_description: A close-up, low-angle shot of a maypole featuring a cluster of vibrant, multi-colored ribbons (pink, yellow, blue, green, purple) hanging vertically from the top center. The background consists of a grassy field and tall pine trees under natural daylight. The pole itself is largely obscured by the density of the ribbons.

Minor warping in the tree trunks on the right side, though likely within normal photographic variance.
